description.en:
A talk lock is a phase where the player has to talk to a set of NPCs (see StartTalkLock). The list lives in the game progress data and holds up to 12 NPCs.
Sets the NPCs of a talk lock from one array: the first element is the type. TL_TYPE_A (1): the other elements are the NPC IDs. TL_TYPE_B (2): the second element is a number, then the NPC IDs. Other types do nothing. StartTalkLock builds the array from its arguments.
